description: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports- Sports Law No. 25 of 1973 National Sports Associations Regulations No. o1 of 2025
reasoning: This gazette contains new regulations made under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973, establishing legal frameworks and compliance requirements for National Sports Associations. It creates binding regulatory requirements for registration, constitution, and governance of sports organizations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel/structure categories.
